messages:
Alex M: hey team — quick sync. PR #21437 is ready for merge but it's stuck behind the CI queue. Freeze window at 18:00 UTC today, so ideally land before that. Can someone help get a mac-e2e slot? (thread_ts 1710612345)

Ben K: what's the blocker? failing tests or just long queue?

Alex M: no failing tests — CI queue shows 'no runners available' and my job is at position 27. not a flaky, just capacity. screenshot: https://example.com/screencap.png

Priya S: @Ben K can you drop any non-urgent jobs? I can bump down mine.

Ben K: I'm running a calibration job that I can cancel; will free ~1 slot. give me 2m.

Jordan L: fyi deploy freeze starts 18:00 UTC — if we miss this, schedule slips to the next blackout. is this PR urgent for the customer bug?

Alex M: yes, customer-facing regression — prefer to land before freeze. Approvals pending from @Priya S and @Jordan L. CI green required.

Mia R: QA can do a 5-min smoke after CI passes. I can be on standby.

Priya S: reviewing now, should be quick. small nits but nothing blocking.

Ben K: cancelled my low-priority run and freed a slot. CI-bot: requeue requested for job 21437.

CI-bot: queued job 21437 on mac-e2e pool, estimated wait ~90s.

Alex M: rebase done (`git pull --rebase origin main`) and pushed. kicking CI again.

Priya S: left one tiny comment inline, i'll auto-approve after you address.

CI-bot: job 21437 started on mac-e2e-07. logs: https://ci.example.com/job/21437/console

Ben K: thanks — looks like it picked up.

merge-bot: merge queue position: 3. waiting for all checks to be green and approvals.

Jordan L: LGTM from me, approving now.

Priya S: approving after the last comment is pushed.

Alex M: pushed fix for Priya's nits. thanks all. kicking final CI.

CI-bot: job 21437 passed all checks. artifacts uploaded.

merge-bot: PR #21437 is eligible for merge. auto-merge scheduled in 30s (backoff window applied).

Alex M: merging now. will watch telemetry for 15m and roll back if we see errors.

Mia R: I'll monitor smoke tests and post results here. good luck :crossed_fingers:

Alex M: merge complete. thanks everyone for the quick slot swap and reviews :thumbsup:

Mia R: smoke tests all green. no errors in staging metrics.

Jordan L: great — closing the loop. if anything pops, i'll open a hotfix plan.

Alex M: noted. thanks again.
